step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows Spot.io's SaaS system managing client AWS infrastructure to optimize spot instance usage. On the Spot.io side, EC2 data collectors collect telemetry and write to Aurora, while SageMaker analyzes Aurora data for interruption prediction. EKS manages the SaaS control plane. On the Client side, CloudFormation deploys IAM cross-account roles, enabling Spot.io to manage client EKS clusters and EC2 Spot Instances.
